items.mainDefect: Migrated hosts bypass normalization, leaving schemes, paths, or whitespace that prevent host matching.

secondary.defect: An unescaped quote in a host value breaks the SQL INSERT and aborts the migration.

items.mainDefect: Host matching lowercases only the stored value, so incoming hosts containing uppercase letters are rejected.

secondary.defect: Stored hosts with port suffixes never match because the lookup compares only the bare URI hostname.

items.mainDefect: Unconditional conversion and deletion of raw *_ids fields loses their data when sideloaded records cannot be resolved.

secondary.defect: A null *_ids value throws when the hydration code calls .map on it.

items.mainDefect: Calling .map without checking the *_ids input causes null values to crash response hydration.

secondary.defect: Unresolved ids remain in the hydrated array as undefined entries.

items.mainDefect: Unconditionally replacing and deleting *_ids fields loses raw ids when the corresponding records are not sideloaded.

secondary.defect: Assigning the hydrated array to the pluralized property can overwrite an existing field of the same name.

items.mainDefect: Indexing empty category query results crashes the migration when the relevant settings or matching categories are missing.

secondary.defect: Migrated hosts retain schemes and paths that prevent them from matching URI hostnames.
An unescaped single quote in a host value breaks the SQL INSERT.

items.mainDefect: Calling .map on a null *_ids value crashes hydration.

secondary.defect: Unconditionally deleting the original id array loses its ids when no matching sideloaded collection exists.
